_comment: VENDORS.md does this twice: each of two source URLs is paired with TWO packaged files, which is ambiguous - the resolver cannot tell which file that URL verifies, so both are pulled out (kept vendored) and surfaced by vendor-ambiguous-source (src/vendor/resolve.js). Because those were the only declarations, splicing them out leaves the parsed manifest empty, so vendor-unparseable also fires (unparsedVendor: nothing parseable remained). Both sources are pinned, so unpinned-vendor-source does not fire. Each finding names its own source URL and file list, but both carry the same message, so they collapse into one entry with a locus line per source URL.
